newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's M1 and M2 up 10 pct in fiscal 95/96.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's M1 and M2 up 10 pct in fiscal 95/96.

text.p: Egypt's M1 money supply rose 10.8 percent in the financial year 1995/96 to 35.097 billion pounds, up from 31.686 billion at the end of the previous year, central bank figures show. M1 money supply is cash in circulation plus current account deposits.
M2 money supply, or M1 plus quasi-money, rose 10.5 percent to 168.022 billion pounds from 152.053 billion a year earlier.
In the last quarter of 1995/6, the April-June period, M1 rose 17.9 percent and M2 rose 16.4 percent.
